name: Flutter Entertainment plc
sector: Consumer Discretionary / Online sports betting & iGaming
moat_justification: FanDuel's #1 US share, global scale and local-hero brands are real, but filing-direct ROIC was -0.7% / -2.8% / +4.7% / +0.1% over 2022-2025 and gross margin fell from 49.1% to 45.2% (42.5% TTM) - no demonstrated pricing power against taxes, promos and now prediction markets; part of the weak ROIC is acquisition-intangible amortization, which keeps the score at 5 rather than lower.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 10.3x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier C (10.3%) vs bull-case tier B (16.6%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: Global betting leader, moat 5/10 with near-zero historical ROIC - at $75.60 it does not clear 15% on current filings (12.9% weighted, IV@15 $62.02 vs $75.60, levered 10.3x net debt/OE); clears 15% only at $62.02 or below.
moat_for: #1 US sportsbook (39% GGR share) and #1 US iGaming (27%) - FanDuel scale, liquidity and brand
Global diversification with local-hero brands (Paddy Power, Betfair, Sky Bet, Snai, Sisal)
Product edge in parlays and proprietary iGaming content; US iGaming revenue +14% in Q2 2026
iGaming compounding diversifies away from volatile sportsbook hold
moat_against: ROIC near zero 2022-2025 and gross margin down ~7pts - pricing power not demonstrated
Prediction markets (Kalshi/Polymarket) compete for handle without the sportsbook tax/licensing burden
Regulatory hostage everywhere: India ban closed Junglee, Brazil ban, rising UK/US gambling taxes
Sports-results (hold) swings whipsaw quarters - Q2 2026 US sportsbook revenue -15%
Leverage 4.3x at Q2 2026 limits stamina in a marketing war
